title: Contrastive Representation Shaping for LLM Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2601.22028v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Most LLM unlearning methods aim to approximate retrain-from-scratch behaviors with minimal distribution shift, often via alignment-style objectives defined in the prediction space. While effective at reducing forgotten content generation, such approaches may act as suppression: forgotten concepts can persist in representations and remain entangled with retained knowledge. We introduce CLReg, a contrastive representation regularizer that identifies forget features while pushing them away from retain features, reducing forget--retain interference while empirically preserving the scale and shape of retain features. As light motivation for the mechanism, we provide a one-step analysis showing that CLReg decreases a simple entanglement proxy in the embedding space. translated_title: 面向大语言模型遗忘的对比表征塑形方法
translated_abstract: 大多数大语言模型遗忘方法旨在通过最小化分布偏移来近似从零重新训练的行为，通常通过在预测空间中定义的对齐式目标来实现。虽然这些方法在减少被遗忘内容的生成方面有效，但它们可能只是起到抑制作用：被遗忘的概念可能仍残留在表征中，并与保留的知识相互纠缠。我们提出了CLReg，一种对比表征正则化器，它能够识别遗忘特征并将其与保留特征推开，在减少遗忘-保留干扰的同时，从经验上保持保留特征的规模和形状。作为该机制的轻量级动机，我们提供了一步分析，表明CLReg能够降低嵌入空间中一个简单的纠缠代理指标。在跨遗忘基准测试和不同规模的大语言模型上，CLReg降低了遗忘-保留表征纠缠，从而增强主流遗忘方法的效果，且不会额外泄露隐私信息。
tldr: 提出CLReg对比表征正则化方法，通过识别遗忘特征并将其与保留特征在表征空间中分离，降低遗忘知识与保留知识的纠缠，从而增强主流大语言模型遗忘方法的效果。
en_tdlr: We propose CLReg, a contrastive representation regularizer that identifies forget features and pushes them away from retain features in representation space, reducing forget-retain entanglement to enhance mainstream LLM unlearning methods.
